name: pixel-art
description: Pixel art: 320x180 internal resolution scaled 4x with nearest filtering, a 16-colour palette quantiser, unshaded colour, no shadows. 2D tiles or 3D.

luma_p50.low: too dark: raise post.exposure by 0.05 or lighting.sun_energy by 0.1, then shoot again (change one value, shoot again, compare)
luma_p50.high: too bright: lower post.exposure by 0.05 or lighting.sun_energy by 0.1, then shoot again (change one value, shoot again, compare)

luma_p5.low: shadows too deep: raise lighting.ambient_energy by 0.05 (change one value, shoot again, compare)
luma_p5.high: shadows too light: lower lighting.ambient_energy by 0.05 (change one value, shoot again, compare)

luma_p95.low: no highlights: raise lighting.sun_energy by 0.1 (change one value, shoot again, compare)
luma_p95.high: highlights too hot: lower lighting.sun_energy by 0.1 or post.exposure by 0.05 (change one value, shoot again, compare)

sat_mean.low: washed out: raise post.adjust.saturation by 0.05 (change one value, shoot again, compare)
sat_mean.high: over-saturated: lower post.adjust.saturation by 0.05 (change one value, shoot again, compare)

clip_black.high: crushed blacks: raise lighting.ambient_energy by 0.05 or post.exposure by 0.05 (change one value, shoot again, compare)

clip_white.high: blown whites: lower post.exposure by 0.05 or lighting.sun_energy by 0.1 (change one value, shoot again, compare)

unique_colors.low: too few colours for this style: check palette/flat settings were not applied to a realistic preset (change one value, shoot again, compare)
unique_colors.high: too many colours: enable material.palette_quantize or use shading flat/unshaded (change one value, shoot again, compare)

flat_fraction.low: too noisy for this style: use shading flat/toon and remove textures (change one value, shoot again, compare)
flat_fraction.high: too flat: shading is unshaded or the frame is mostly one colour (change one value, shoot again, compare)

local_contrast.low: too smooth: more geometry/detail (change one value, shoot again, compare)
local_contrast.high: too busy: fewer fine textures (change one value, shoot again, compare)

calibration.method: probe_targets = measured value +- margin on the style probe hero view (gg_style.py calibrate)

calibration_level.method: targets = overview of two 256 m terrains with sea (island seed 1 relief 40 m, hills seed 7 relief 30 m; preset layer template) spanned +- margin; gg_light.py calibrate
